DEMO event Hang out Alcohol-free

SunRail social: ride in, meet up, tacos

  • Thu, Jan 21 · 5:30 to 7:30 pm
  • Lake Mary SunRail station, Lake Mary · Free (food and train fare on your own)

Are you in?

I'm in
ASR+1619 going (DEMO)

Part of January’s lineup, which drops Tue, Dec 15 at noon (DEMO). You can save a seat now.

This one already happened. Here’s what’s next.

Meet on the Lake Mary platform after work, then walk to tacos and talk about getting around Seminole.

What's the plan

Ride in from Sanford, Longwood, Altamonte Springs or farther, or just drive to the station. We meet on the Lake Mary platform, then walk to a taco spot nearby to talk about buses, trains, sidewalks and what it would take to get around here without a car. SunRail runs weekdays only, so this one's on a Thursday. Check sunrail.com for your train in and your last train home.

Getting in

The walk to tacos is short and flat. Need a hand getting there, or a ride back to your car? Tell us when you RSVP and we'll sort it out. Under 18? Any ride needs your guardian's written OK, and you're never alone in a car with one adult.

Who it's for

14 and up. You don't have to be a member, and you don't have to be registered with any party.

Under 18? Events that end after dark, and door-knocking shifts, need a quick OK from a parent or guardian. We'll send the form when you RSVP.

DEMO host · Room for 30 (DEMO)

What to bring

  • Train fare (current prices are on sunrail.com)
  • Comfy shoes
  • Your best transit complaint

First time? Here's what happens

  1. Tap I’m in. A first name and one way to reach you, that’s it. No account.

  2. The day before, you get one reminder with the details.

  3. Show up, look for the celery-green sign (DEMO), and someone will say hi and introduce you around.

Where the facts on this page come from

  • SunRail currently runs Monday to Friday only, every 30 minutes at peak and every 2 to 2.5 hours off-peak.

  • Four SunRail stations are in Seminole County: Altamonte Springs, Longwood, Lake Mary and Sanford.

    Source: sunrail.com

The fine print

We ask before we post anyone's photo, and a parent or guardian says yes first for anyone under 18. Rather not be in pictures? Tell us at check-in.

We never collect forms, signatures or personal information at events. You do everything yourself on official sites.

Be kind, let people finish their sentences, and look out for each other. Anyone who harasses someone is asked to leave.
